C0382.title: Shanghai's First Professional Store Closer Tao Sentenced to 5 Years for Zero-Yuan Gym Takeover and Fleecing
C0382.summary: Defendant Tao, in less than one year, took over four failing fitness clubs in Shanghai through zero-yuan transfers, lured over 200 consumers into prepaying 750,000 yuan in membership fees with low prices, then quickly closed the gyms and absconded while defaulting on rent and wages.
